prompt: I clearly recall (say / tell) to you last week that this phone charger would stop working soon.
explanation_ru: После глагола recall (вспоминать) используется герундий (-ing), а с предлогом to употребляется say (say to somebody), тогда как tell не требует предлога to.

prompt: In nineteenth-century market towns, travellers frequently paid palm readers to (say / tell) their fortunes before setting off.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение tell someone's fortune означает «предсказывать чью-либо судьбу / гадать».

prompt: If I (say / tell) you a secret about the new manager, do you promise not to breathe a word to anyone?
explanation_ru: С существительным a secret (секрет) используется глагол tell в устойчивом сочетании tell someone a secret.

prompt: Any official caught (say / tell) a lie during the public inquiry risks immediate dismissal.
explanation_ru: Со словом a lie (ложь) употребляется глагол tell (tell a lie — солгать), а конструкция caught doing требует формы с окончанием -ing.

prompt: Regardless of what the weather station display may (say / tell), the mountain guides refuse to climb when thick fog rolls in.
explanation_ru: Когда речь идет о показаниях приборов, датчиков или тексте на экране, в английском языке используется глагол say.

prompt: If you accidentally knocked over that pedestrian's shopping bag, the least you can do is (say / tell) sorry.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении say sorry (извиниться) используется только глагол say.

prompt: According to the digital sign on the highway, it (say / tell) minus six degrees ahead, so drive carefully.
explanation_ru: Для передачи информации, написанной на знаке, табло или термометре, используется глагол say (it says).

prompt: The chairperson firmly (say / tell) the board members not to leak confidential figures to the press.
explanation_ru: Для передачи приказа или просьбы с дополнением (tell somebody not to do something) используется глагол tell.

prompt: My physiotherapist (say / tell) me yesterday to stretch my lower back every morning before work.
explanation_ru: Модель tell + дополнение (me) + инфинитив (to stretch) используется для передачи совета или инструкции.

prompt: “Don't lean against the freshly varnished door,” the carpenter (say / tell) me as I entered the hallway.
explanation_ru: Поскольку сразу после глагола стоит прямое дополнение без предлога (me), необходимо выбрать глагол told.

prompt: Seldom can a casual drinker (say / tell) the difference between a single malt and a blended whisky in a blind tasting.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение tell the difference означает «видеть разницу / отличать одно от другого».

prompt: Even from the upper balcony, I could easily (say / tell) that the lead actor had forgotten his lines.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell после модального глагола can/could часто имеет значение «понять, определить, заметить».

prompt: In dim lighting, my grandfather struggles to (say / tell) the time on his antique pocket watch.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое словосочетание tell the time означает «определять время по часам».

prompt: For centuries, the ruined castle on the cliff was (say / tell) to hold hidden royal treasure.
explanation_ru: Безличная пассивная конструкция be said to do something означает «говорят, что... / считается, что...».

prompt: Thanks for letting me know about your trip to Lyon next week. Please (say / tell) hello to your sister from me when you meet up for dinner. Also, (say / tell) her that I will send the photos from our summer holiday tomorrow.
explanation_ru: В первом случае используется устойчивое выражение say hello (передать привет), во втором — tell + адресат (her) + придаточное с that.

prompt: The client offered a generous bonus for rushing the project through. However, the lead engineer firmly (say / tell) no to the unrealistic deadline. She (say / tell) the management team that quality would suffer if they skipped testing.
explanation_ru: Слова yes и no употребляются с глаголом say (say no — ответить отказом), а перед прямым дополнением (the management team) ставится told.

prompt: Safety officers visited the main factory floor yesterday morning. Having been (say / tell) twice to wear safety glasses, two workers were still working without them. The manager (say / tell) that strict action would follow right away.
explanation_ru: Пассивная форма be told to do something используется для передачи распоряжений, а say that вводит косвенную речь без указания слушателя.

prompt: Everyone in our study group arrived an hour early for the biology lecture today. Who (say / tell) you that the class had been postponed until noon? I checked the noticeboard yesterday, and it didn't (say / tell) anything about a schedule change.
explanation_ru: После глагола стоит дополнение you, поэтому нужен глагол told; для описания содержания надписи на доске используется say.

prompt: I am expecting an urgent parcel from the pharmacy this afternoon. Could you (say / tell) the courier to ring the side bell if I am out in the garden? Please also (say / tell) thank you to him for carrying the heavy box up the steps.
explanation_ru: Конструкция tell somebody to do something передает просьбу или указание, а благодарность выражается устойчивой фразой say thank you.

prompt: The check into the cycling team's big problem ended yesterday. After being caught (say / tell) lies to the sports committee, the coach lost his job. In his final words, he (say / tell) to reporters that he was deeply sorry for his actions.
explanation_ru: Выражение tell lies требует глагола tell (в форме -ing после caught), а перед предлогом to (to reporters) всегда используется say.

prompt: Both of these clay cups are made by hand and painted in the exact same green color. How do you (say / tell) them apart on the shelf? The shop worker (say / tell) me to look at the small maker's mark on the bottom.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол tell apart означает «различать», а tell me to look следует модели tell + объект + инфинитив.

prompt: Have you ever visited an astrologer who claimed they could ___ your fortune from your birth chart?
explanation_ru: Устойчивое сочетание tell someone's fortune означает «предсказывать судьбу».

prompt: The ancient Roman villa near the harbour is ___ to have belonged to a wealthy olive oil merchant.
explanation_ru: В пассивной конструкции с инфинитивом (is said to have belonged — говорят, что принадлежала) используется только глагол say.

prompt: The notice on the museum entrance door ___ “No flash photography inside the gallery”.
explanation_ru: Для передачи текста объявления, вывески или таблички в английском языке используется глагол say.

prompt: It is widely ___ that learning to play a musical instrument improves memory at any age.
explanation_ru: Безличный оборот It is widely said that... переводится как «широко распространено мнение, что... / часто говорят, что...».

prompt: Had the car repairman ___ us about the old brake parts earlier, we would never have driven into the mountains.
explanation_ru: Модель tell somebody about something используется для сообщения информации конкретному адресату (us).

prompt: Grab a cup of tea and say me all about your hiking trip in Scotland.
answer: Grab a cup of tea and tell me all about your hiking trip in Scotland.
accepted_answers: Grab a cup of tea and tell me all about your hiking trip in Scotland.
explanation_ru: После глагола say нельзя сразу ставить личное местоимение (me) без предлога to; для конструкции «рассказать кому-то о чём-то» используется tell somebody about something.

prompt: While we were waiting at the station, a local guide told us about the historic railway bridge.
answer: While we were waiting at the station, a local guide told us about the historic railway bridge.
accepted_answers: While we were waiting at the station, a local guide told us about the historic railway bridge.
explanation_ru: Предложение построено верно: глагол told правильно сочетается с прямым дополнением us и предлогом about (tell somebody about something).

prompt: Unless you inspect the stitching closely, it is almost impossible to say the fake leather bags from the real ones.
answer: Unless you inspect the stitching closely, it is almost impossible to tell the fake leather bags from the real ones.
accepted_answers: Unless you inspect the stitching closely, it is almost impossible to tell the fake leather bags from the real ones.
explanation_ru: В значении «отличить одно от другого» используется устойчивая конструкция tell A from B, а не say.

prompt: Why did you say a lie when Dad asked who had broken the kitchen window?
answer: Why did you tell a lie when Dad asked who had broken the kitchen window?
accepted_answers: Why did you tell a lie when Dad asked who had broken the kitchen window?
explanation_ru: С существительным a lie (ложь) используется только глагол tell (tell a lie — солгать), но не say.

prompt: Your coworker Leo is completely safe with private client information. Which sentence describes him naturally?
options: Leo never says secrets to anyone in the office because he values people's trust.
Leo never tells secrets to anyone in the office because he values people's trust.
Leo never tells secrets anyone in the office because he values people's trust.
Leo never says secrets anyone in the office because he values people's trust.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое сочетание «выдавать/рассказывать секреты кому-либо» строится по модели tell secrets to someone.

prompt: Many food critics share the same high opinion of a local olive harvest. Which sentence expresses this naturally?
options: It is widely said to chefs that the autumn olive harvest was the richest in ten years.
It is widely told among chefs that the autumn olive harvest was the richest in ten years.
It is widely said among chefs that the autumn olive harvest was the richest in ten years.
It is widely told to among chefs that the autumn olive harvest was the richest in ten years.
explanation_ru: Безличная пассивная конструкция It is widely said that... требует глагола said и не допускает использования told.

prompt: Rewrite the sentence using the verb 'say' instead of 'show': What time does the wall clock show? My phone battery is dead.
answer: What time does the wall clock say? My phone battery is dead.
accepted_answers: What time does the wall clock say? My phone battery is dead.
What does the wall clock say? My phone battery is dead.
explanation_ru: Чтобы спросить, какое время показывают часы, в естественном английском языке используется глагол say (What time does the clock say?).

prompt: Rewrite the sentence using the verb 'say' instead of 'state': Does the user guide state how to clean the coffee machine filter?
answer: Does the user guide say how to clean the coffee machine filter?
accepted_answers: Does the user guide say how to clean the coffee machine filter?
explanation_ru: Для обозначения того, что написано в инструкции, книге или документе, вместо формального state употребляется глагол say.
